Before you continue

Terms, privacy & safety notice

This software cannot reliably detect or remove every private detail.

Do not enter names, exact addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, account numbers, private records, secrets, or information about another person. Automated checks can miss information, especially when it is disguised or included intentionally.

  • Answers are generated guidance, may be wrong, and are not professional medical, legal, financial, emergency, or safety advice.
  • Questions should be asked in good faith with a direction that could benefit people—not to target, exploit, deceive, or harm.
  • This prototype stores your profile, questions, reactions, and comments only in this browser. Future public storage will require a separate notice.
  • Your browser ID is pseudonymous—not proof of identity. Clearing browser data may create a new ID.
  • Participation is not consent to AI training. This prototype does not send contributions into a training dataset. Any future dataset program must use a separate, optional, informed choice.
Prototype notice · policy version 0.2 · not a substitute for a lawyer-reviewed Terms of Use and Privacy Notice.

The Tree of Life

A two-dimensional map of the first five knowledge levels. Every question begins as an unconnected seed.

New seed Connected branch Tested solution
2D prototype · relationships are illustrative
LEVEL 1 · PURPOSE
LEVEL 2 · DOMAINS
LEVEL 3 · TAG SPACES
LEVEL 4 · QUESTION CLUSTERS
LEVEL 5 · LEAVES
Select a node to inspect its place in the hierarchy.

Connections are suggested by shared tags, meaning, and community review. People can challenge a connection. The map preserves useful differences; no branch becomes “truth” simply because it is popular.

A starting point—not a verdict

Your solution brief

01 · BEST-CASE SCENARIO

A practical improvement you can test safely

Define the smallest positive result, try a reversible step, and record what changes before expanding it.

02 · WHY

Learning before scaling reduces avoidable harm

A small test makes assumptions visible and lets people compare the proposal with lived experience.

03 · THE DEEPER WHY

Turn one person’s learning into reusable public value

When context, limitations, outcomes, and respectful disagreement are preserved, others can adapt the insight without treating it as universal truth.
